stem_book: If α = cos(2π/5) + i sin(2π/5) is a fifth root of unity, then (a) |1 + α + α² + α³ + α⁴| = 0 (b) |1 + α + α² + α³| = 1 (c) |1 + α + α²| = 2cos(π/5) (d) |1 + α| = 2cos(π/10)
reason: Print says just 'the fifth root of unity': α = 1 breaks (a), and α = e^(±4πi/5) gives |1 + α + α²| = 2cos(2π/5), breaking (c); stem_book fixes α = e^(2πi/5), the root the key intends.
